name: Pineapple, fresh whole
storage: Keep whole at room temperature until ripe; refrigerate cut pieces in a closed box and use within about 3 days.
looksLike: A spiky green-brown to golden-yellow fruit with a leafy crown; the flesh is pale to golden yellow, juicy and sweet-tart. Sold by the piece (about 800 g to 1 kg) in India.
howToPick: Heavy for its size, a sweet smell at the base, a golden-yellow colour near the bottom, and crown leaves that look green and fresh. Avoid a fermented or sour smell, soft wet spots or mould.
shelfLife: Ripe whole fruit lasts about 2 to 3 days on the counter and a few days in the fridge once cut (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Raisins or a little chopped ripe mango

usedIn.raw: 15 g per serving (1 tbsp chopped); the Jain variant also keeps it

mergeNotes: Range 75.0–180.0 was wider than 30% of avg 135.0; narrowed to ±15%.
